summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-G6 admits no external crate. academic-consent links academic-domain and thiserror as product edges and academic-domain, academic-retention and trybuild as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-consent is the P2-G6 consent ledger and section 3.7 capture-permission model. It is a separate package rather than a module of academic-policy because the broker's request tuple carries a consent_evidence_id that nothing in this workspace validates, and an edge in either direction would make it look as though this crate did.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-consent is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns the section 3.7 capture_permission aggregate, the append-only consent ledger and its closed event vocabulary, the type separation that keeps a user attestation from producing a permitting status, the two independent retention axes and the inheritance rule that may only narrow them, and the deletion-impact preview an expiry cannot be applied without. academic-domain is its only product edge, for the identifier and digest types. academic-retention is deliberately a dev edge: rotation_engine_lane_is_not_default holds that exactly one crate declares a product edge to it because linking it links a crate that can destroy a key slot, so this crate restates that crate's derivative-class list and the_two_derivative_vocabularies_are_the_same_list compares the two whole through the dev edge.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It holds no clock: every instant it compares is an argument. Its link closure holds nothing that can open a socket beyond libc, which reaches it through academic-domain. Every fixture in its test tree is synthetic and built from committed literals. only_egress_crate_has_a_socket in tools/phase1-scaffold-policy.test.mjs pins its socket allowance at absent.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-consent links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
